name: Witchwing Talon
summary: In the northwestern Barrens, Witchwing Talons mark dead harpy raiders. Horde scouts at the Crossroads seek them as proof while they work to secure vital caravan routes.

sections.title: Trophies from the Roosts
sections.body: Witchwing harpies raid Horde supply caravans from their roosts northwest of the Crossroads. Scout Darsok Swiftdagger coordinates strikes against the flock's hierarchy. Darsok requires physical proof of each dead scavenger, and the talons provide it. With proof that raiders have fallen, the scouts can weaken the flock's ranks before striking higher in its command.

faq.q: Who wants Witchwing Talons and why?
faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc scout at the Crossroads, collects them. He plans a campaign against the Witchwing brood and requires eight talons as proof that its frontline raiders have been slain.
Witchwing Talons come from harpies in the northwestern Barrens, including common harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers that nest along the cliffs and dry ridges.

faq.q: Why are the Witchwing harpies being targeted?
faq.answer: The Witchwing flock has grown increasingly bold, attacking Horde supply lines and trade caravans across the Barrens. Darsok aims to thin its lower ranks before striking its lieutenants and matriarch.

angles.text: Caravans connect Kalimdor's scattered Horde outposts, so clearing the harpy roosts helps secure the frontier.
Darsok Swiftdagger values quiet, precise attacks. To him, these sharp claws mark the work of a skilled killer against aerial predators.
